HPI at NEREUS workshop at the GFZ Potsdam

Benjamin Hagedorn contributed to the workshop "GeoInformationsWirtschaft trifft GeoForschung und GeoGovernment" organized by the Department of Commerce of the state of Brandenburg and the GFZ Potsdam and held on November 18th, 2011, at the GFZ in the context of Brandenburg's membership in the NEREUS project. Benjamin presented work in the area of service-oriented 3D geovisualization done at the Computer Graphics System group at the Hasso Plattner Institute.
